It will take Arrow's tally to 180 career NRL games and 100 for the Rabbitohs, in addition to his representative appearances for Queensland in the annual State of Origin series.

Australian Rugby League Commission chairman Peter V'landys said it was a chance for the sport to be a "conduit to bring out the best of humanity".

"This thoughtful gesture by the South Sydney Rabbitohs shows the true heart of our game," V'landys said. "Jai has inspired millions of people around the world with the courage and strength he has shown in his fight with MND. He is not only a great player, but an extraordinary person.

"Reaching 100 games for the Rabbitohs is a special achievement, one that Jai, his family and everyone who has supported him should be incredibly proud of. The entire rugby league community stands with Jai and is honoured to celebrate this remarkable milestone with him."

Rugby league star Rob Burrow and Scotland rugby union great Doddie Weir are among the high-profile sportsmen to have died from the illness in recent years.

articles.title: "Julián está atrapado en su propia telaraña"
articles.standfirst: Sólo un perdón público del argentino a la afición del Atlético y que se coma el césped en cada partido podría solucionar su situación
articles.summary: Sólo un perdón público del argentino a la afición del Atlético y que se coma el césped en cada partido podría solucionar su situación
articles.body: El Metropolitano se pronunció y como era de esperar, la hinchada del Atlético de Madrid le mostró el pulgar hacia abajo a Julián Álvarez. La pitada que dedicó al argentino en el partido frente al Villarreal fue como para que 'La Araña' tome ya la decisión que le permitiría escapar de la telaraña en la que él solito se ha enredado. Pero su rictus en el banquillo y su indolencia cuando saltó al terreno de juego en la segunda parte no invitan a pensar que este 'culebrón' vaya a acabar bien. En la última semana de mercado, me da que el 19 del Atleti aún alberga la esperanza de que el club le deje salir porque si no, no se entiende que a esta hora todavía no le haya pedido perdón públicamente a la afición rojiblanca y, aún así, tendría muy difícil lograr el indulto de la parroquia colchonera.  Griezmann se arrepintió del fondo y las formas cuando se marchó precisamente al Barça también y, a base de goles, consiguió cambiar los pitos en aplausos volviéndose a ganar el cariño del Metropolitano. La diferencia es que Antoine ya era un ídolo del Atlético cuando cogió el puente aéreo y su ariete argentino no lo es. De hecho, en su segunda temporada con Simeone ha firmado un curso algo más que discreto. Es más, se tiró casi cuatro meses sin marcar y no recibió ni un reproche de su afición. Esta temporada no va a poder cumplir 'su sueño' de vestir la camiseta azulgrana. Creo que hasta que se resuelva su futuro, no debería jugar más. Está claro que su presencia en el equipo, ahora mismo, resta más que suma. Y después, a apechugar, 'Araña'.

articles.title: Carabao Cup 2026-27: How does prize money work in the competition?
articles.summary: BBC Sport's Ask Me Anything team explains how prize money works in the EFL Cup
articles.body:
Compared to other cup competitions such as the FA Cup and Champions League, the EFL Cup uses a different payment structure when it comes to prize money for teams.

While most competitions have a structured round-by-round monetary prize, including in its qualifying rounds, the EFL Cup only has specific round prize money from the semi-finals onward.

The EFL Cup winners get Â£100,000 in prize money. For comparison, this season's FA Cup winners will earn just over Â£2.1m in prize money.

Instead of a large prize pot, clubs earn revenue in a number of different ways, with the English Football League seeing those as effectively the competition's prize money.

In the EFL Cup, clubs are offered an equal split of gate receipts regardless of the two teams in the fixture. This can benefit lower league clubs if they are drawn away to a big Premier League side that has a larger stadium than they do.

Should a club sell 40,000 tickets for a match at Â£20 each, it would equate to Â£800,000 in gate receipts.

Clubs can also achieve significant earnings through EFL Cup Facility Fees. This means that clubs can pocket a fee starting from Â£75,000 if their match is shown on Sky Sports' main channel, increasing depending on how far they progress in the competition.

The EFL Cup is worth around Â£110m a season to the EFL, including around Â£70m going to EFL clubs in central payments with additional monies to Premier League and EFL clubs from direct earnings.

Why don't Chelsea or Sunderland have a shirt sponsor?

Why are Brighton and Hearts both allowed in the Conference League?

When is the Champions League draw and who is in each pot?

articles.title: El Rayo cierra el fichaje de Gnangoro Bouare
articles.standfirst: El club franjirrojo concreta el traspaso del centrocampista del Betis, adelantado por Radio MARCA y MARCA el pasado 12 de agosto, y el jugador firmará por cinco temporadas tras pasar reconocimiento médico
articles.summary: El club franjirrojo concreta el traspaso del centrocampista del Betis, adelantado por Radio MARCA y MARCA el pasado 12 de agosto, y el jugador firmará por cinco temporadas tras pasar reconocimiento médico
articles.body: Lo que MARCA y Radio MARCA adelantó el pasado 12 de agosto ya es una realidad. Gnangoro Bouare va a jugar en el Rayo Vallecano. El centrocampista de Vícar, de 22 años, ya está en Madrid después de que el club franjirrojo haya cerrado este martes su traspaso con el Betis. El jugador pasará reconocimiento médico y firmará un contrato por las próximas cinco temporadas. El movimiento pone punto final a una operación que el Rayo tenía encarrilada desde hace tiempo por una vía muy concreta: la opción preferencial que conservaba sobre el futbolista desde el fichaje de Nobel Mendy. En aquel acuerdo, el club vallecano abonó 500.000 euros para asegurarse una posición de ventaja por Bouare. Ahora, para completar la llegada del centrocampista, ha tenido que pagar alrededor de otros 100.000 euros en concepto de impuestos. La operación también deja al Betis con un porcentaje importante sobre el futuro del jugador. El club verdiblanco se guarda el 50% de los derechos de Bouare y mantiene, además, un derecho de tanteo. Una fórmula que permite al Rayo incorporar a un futbolista que gustaba en Vallecas sin realizar una inversión elevada, mientras el Betis conserva margen de control sobre una posible evolución del centrocampista. Bouare acaba contrato en 2027 y tenía sobre la mesa una oferta del Betis para renovar por tres temporadas más. En Heliópolis habían demostrado que creían en su progresión, pero también eran conscientes del contexto: el jugador tenía mercado, quería definir su futuro deportivo y el Rayo había activado una vía preferencial que terminó siendo decisiva. Gnangoro llegó al Betis en enero de 2025 procedente del Polideportivo El Ejido y fue cedido ese mismo mercado al Atlético Sanluqueño. La temporada 2025-2026 ya la disputó con el filial verdiblanco, con el que jugó 30 partidos antes de dar un paso al frente esta pretemporada aprovechando la salida de Amrabat y ganando presencia en los planes de Manuel Pellegrini. El técnico chileno le dio espacio en una posición de pivote en la que cuenta con Marc Roca y Facundo Bernal, fichado este verano procedente de Fluminense. Bouare respondió con personalidad y se convirtió en una de las apariciones más interesantes del verano bético, hasta el punto de llamar definitivamente la atención del Rayo. El club franjirrojo incorpora a un centrocampista joven, físico y con margen de crecimiento. Un perfil que encaja en la búsqueda de fondo de armario para la medular y que llega a Vallecas después de haber despertado también el interés de clubes de Segunda como Córdoba, Burgos y Cádiz durante este verano. El Rayo, sin embargo, tenía una ventaja heredada del caso Nobel Mendy y la ha terminado aprovechando. Bouare ya está en Madrid, pasará reconocimiento médico y firmará por cinco temporadas. Una operación trabajada desde hace semanas que convierte una opción preferencial en un refuerzo de presente y futuro para Vallecas.

articles.title: El sorprendente favorito para hacerse con la Super Bowl
articles.standfirst: Para Casino Gran Madrid los Rams son el principal candidato
articles.summary: Para Casino Gran Madrid los Rams son el principal candidato
articles.body: La NFL echa a andar su temporada 2026 el próximo 10 de septiembre, apenas siete meses después de que los Seattle Seahawks se proclamaran campeones del Super Bowl LX al imponerse 29-13 a los New England Patriots en el Levi's Stadium, con una exhibición defensiva y una gran noche de Kenneth Walker III, MVP del partido.  Con la pretemporada prácticamente cerrada y los 32 equipos afinando sus plantillas de cara al arranque, las casas de apuestas ya han fijado su jerarquía particular para el Super Bowl LXI, que se disputará el 14 de febrero de 2027 en el SoFi Stadium de Los Ángeles. Casino Gran Madrid ha publicado su lista de favoritos, y hay bastante consenso con lo que ya adelantaban los expertos nada más terminar la pasada final. Y es que, el trono no está garantizado ni para el propio campeón. El gran favorito de la casa de apuestas es Los Angeles Rams, a cuota 6. El equipo de Sean McVay, con Matthew Stafford como MVP de la liga la pasada temporada, llegó hasta la final de conferencia y juega además como local en un Super Bowl que se disputará en su propio estadio, un aliciente extra que el mercado parece haber tenido muy en cuenta a la hora de colocarlo en lo más alto. Le sigue de cerca Buffalo Bills, a cuota 10, con Josh Allen de nuevo como gran estandarte de un proyecto que año tras año se queda a las puertas de la gloria y que vuelve a aparecer entre los máximos aspirantes del mercado. En tercera posición aparecen, empatados a cuota 12, los propios campeones vigentes, Seattle Seahawks, y Baltimore Ravens, el equipo de Lamar Jackson. Que los Seahawks no encabecen el mercado pese a llegar como último campeón no es ninguna sorpresa: la historia reciente de la liga demuestra lo difícil que resulta revalidar el título, con apenas nueve franquicias logrando defenderlo de forma consecutiva, y Seattle afronta además la habitual sangría de bajas en agencia libre que sufren los campeones. Los Ravens, por su parte, siguen siendo un habitual de la parte alta de estos mercados gracias al talento de Jackson, aunque el equipo estrena entrenador esta temporada, una variable que el mercado también pondera. El siguiente escalón lo comparten tres nombres muy reconocibles a cuota 17: Kansas City Chiefs, con Patrick Mahomes buscando demostrar que su ventana de éxito sigue abierta pese a acercarse a los 31 años; Philadelphia Eagles, campeones hace dos temporadas y todavía con plantilla para pelear arriba; y los propios New England Patriots, finalistas la pasada campaña de la mano de un Drake Maye que, pese a la decepción de la final, dejó números de quarterback de época durante la temporada regular. Un peldaño por debajo, a cuota 18, aparecen Los Angeles Chargers y Houston Texans, dos equipos jóvenes con plantillas en plena progresión que el mercado sitúa como aspirantes con opciones reales, aunque todavía a cierta distancia del grupo de cabeza. Cierran la lista de referencia, ya a cuota 20, cinco franquicias con seguimiento habitual en estos mercados: Detroit Lions, Denver Broncos, San Francisco 49ers, Green Bay Packers y Cincinnati Bengals. Ninguno de los cinco parte como favorito claro, pero todos cuentan con plantillas de nivel suficiente como para colarse en la pelea si consiguen mantenerse alejados de la enfermería durante el tramo más exigente del calendario. Con siete meses por delante hasta la cita del SoFi Stadium, el mercado deja claro que, aunque hay un favorito nítido en los Rams, la distancia hasta el resto del pelotón de cabeza sigue siendo relativamente corta.

articles.title: Sir Billy Boston: Trailblazing rugby league player dies aged 92
articles.summary: Trailblazing rugby league player Sir Billy Boston has died at the age of 92; He was the first ever rugby league player to receive a knighthood, ending a 130-year wait for such an honour; He was also the first Black player to represent Great Britain
articles.body:
Iconic rugby league player Sir Billy Boston has died aged 92.

Back in June 2025, Boston received rugby league's first ever knighthood, ending a 130-year wait for such an honour.

A statement released by Wales Rugby League said: "Today, rugby league has lost one of its greatest-ever players, Wales has lost one of its finest sporting sons, and our sport has lost a truly special gentleman."

The Welsh Rugby Union confirmed his death in a statement, saying: "Sir Billy Boston, one of the best loved and most iconic figures in the history of Welsh sport, has passed away peacefully at the age of 92."

Boston blazed a trail for Black sports stars during the 1950s and 1960s, making 488 appearances for Wigan and finishing his career with a British-record 571 tries.

He also became the first non-white player to represent Great Britain on a Lions tour in 1954, scoring 36 tries in 18 appearances in Australia and New Zealand, and featuring in a total of 31 international Test matches.

Boston made a try-scoring debut for Wigan against Barrow in November 1953, and by the time he left the club in 1968, he had played in six Challenge Cup finals at Wembley, featuring on the winning side in 1958, 1959 and 1965.

'A giant of a man in every way'

Prime Minister Andy Burnham, an avid follower of the sport, led the tributes to Boston.

Burnham wrote on X: "Heartbroken to hear my friend Sir Billy Boston has died.

"Billy was one of the greatest rugby league players of all time but also one of the kindest and most down-to-earth people you could ever wish to meet.

"He always had time for people and gave so much to back to his adopted home, Wigan.

"I will miss him greatly and am thinking today of Billy's family, still grieving the recent loss of his beloved wife Joan.

"A giant of a man in every way. Thank you, Billy, and rest in peace."

Wigan have indicated they will pay tribute to Boston prior to their next Super League match against Hull KR on Thursday.

Wigan head coach Matt Peet said: "On behalf of myself, our coaching staff and players, from the first team through to our academy, we send our deepest condolences to Sir Billy's family, friends and loved ones at this incredibly sad time.

"Billy Boston is woven into the fabric of this club. Every day we walk through the doors, we're reminded that we have a responsibility to represent all those who have gone before us and made Wigan Warriors what it is today. Billy stands at the very top of that history.

"Those fortunate enough to have seen him play tell me he was simply the greatest. His achievements, the man he was and the standards he set will continue to inspire everyone who pulls on this shirt.

"His legacy goes far beyond records and trophies. His impact on Wigan, on rugby league and on the wider sporting world was recognised at the very highest level. We will do everything we can to honour his memory by representing this club with the pride, humility and excellence that he embodied.

"Sir Billy Boston will always be one of Wigan Warriors' greatest sons, and he will never be forgotten."

'One of rugby league's finest' - tributes paid to 'King of Wigan' Boston

Wigan Warriors legend Colin Clarke:

"In 1953 he played his first game at Wigan and he became my hero, then my team mate then my friend for 60-odd years.

"I treasure the time I had with Billy - a brilliant player on the field and even better person off the field."

Wigan and Great Britain rugby league legend Shaun Edwards:

"From a working class lad in Cardiff to the King of Wigan - that is Sir Billy Boston."

Sky Sports Rugby League's Brian Carney:

"When the Wigan representatives stood in the Boston household in Tiger Bay, Cardiff in 1953 and offered Billy a career in rugby league in the North of England it was Billy's mother who told him in no uncertain terms that he would be taking the offer.

"We all have Mrs Boston to thank for giving rugby league one of its finest ever. Billy glowed greatness.

"I have listened to the hardest of rugby league men from Billy's era talk about his presence on the field. The hulking figure they dare not get angry.

"A sensational try scorer who could handle himself if and when the game got physical. Thanks for everything you gave people Billy."

Boston's journey to icon status

On August 6 1934 in Cardiff, Billy Boston was born to his father John, a seaman from Sierra Leone and his mother Nellie, from the city's Irish community.

Primarily a winger and centre, Boston's rugby career began in the 15-player code in which he represented Wales at youth level.

However, it was not without its struggles. His hometown club Cardiff RFC did not offer him and other Black and mixed-race players a contract.

Such racism also denied him the opportunity to represent Wales and with it, he made the decision to switch codes and join Wigan Warriors.

At 18 years of age in March 1953, Boston signed for Wigan before making his debut eight months later. That would be the first of 488 and crossing the whitewash became customary as he scored 478 tries across that time.

In 1954 more history followed when Boston became the first non-white player to be selected for a Great Britain Rugby League Lions Tour.

Boston became a World Cup winner in 1960, scoring a try in Great Britain's win over Australia and then a second Lions Tour followed in 1962.

His international career saw him score 24 tries across 31 Tests for Great Britain. His other Tour appearances added a remarkable 53 tries in 27 games.

After 16 years with Wigan, Boston joined Blackpool Borough and made 11 appearances and scored five tries, ending his domestic career with 499 appearances.

Boston's career ended at 36 years of age and the statistics are staggering. He scored 571 tries, the second most in rugby league history.

A rugby league immortal, he has three statues - situated in Wales, Wigan, and at Wembley Stadium.

A statement released by Wales Rugby League said: "Today, rugby league has lost one of its greatest-ever players, Wales has lost one of its finest sporting sons, and our sport has lost a truly special gentleman."

The Welsh Rugby Union confirmed his death in a statement, saying: "Sir Billy Boston, one of the best loved and most iconic figures in the history of Welsh sport, has passed away peacefully at the age of 92."

Boston blazed a trail for Black sports stars during the 1950s and 1960s, making 488 appearances for Wigan and finishing his career with a British-record 571 tries.

He also became the first non-white player to represent Great Britain on a Lions tour in 1954, scoring 36 tries in 18 appearances in Australia and New Zealand, and featuring in a total of 31 international Test matches.

Boston made a try-scoring debut for Wigan against Barrow in November 1953, and by the time he left the club in 1968, he had played in six Challenge Cup finals at Wembley, featuring on the winning side in 1958, 1959 and 1965.

'A giant of a man in every way'

Prime Minister Andy Burnham, an avid follower of the sport, led the tributes to Boston.

Burnham wrote on X: "Heartbroken to hear my friend Sir Billy Boston has died.

"Billy was one of the greatest rugby league players of all time but also one of the kindest and most down-to-earth people you could ever wish to meet.

"He always had time for people and gave so much to back to his adopted home, Wigan.

"I will miss him greatly and am thinking today of Billy's family, still grieving the recent loss of his beloved wife Joan.

"A giant of a man in every way. Thank you, Billy, and rest in peace."

Wigan have indicated they will pay tribute to Boston prior to their next Super League match against Hull KR on Thursday.

Wigan head coach Matt Peet said: "On behalf of myself, our coaching staff and players, from the first team through to our academy, we send our deepest condolences to Sir Billy's family, friends and loved ones at this incredibly sad time.

"Billy Boston is woven into the fabric of this club. Every day we walk through the doors, we're reminded that we have a responsibility to represent all those who have gone before us and made Wigan Warriors what it is today. Billy stands at the very top of that history.

"Those fortunate enough to have seen him play tell me he was simply the greatest. His achievements, the man he was and the standards he set will continue to inspire everyone who pulls on this shirt.

"His legacy goes far beyond records and trophies. His impact on Wigan, on rugby league and on the wider sporting world was recognised at the very highest level. We will do everything we can to honour his memory by representing this club with the pride, humility and excellence that he embodied.

"Sir Billy Boston will always be one of Wigan Warriors' greatest sons, and he will never be forgotten."

'One of rugby league's finest' - tributes paid to 'King of Wigan' Boston

Wigan Warriors legend Colin Clarke:

"In 1953 he played his first game at Wigan and he became my hero, then my team mate then my friend for 60-odd years.

"I treasure the time I had with Billy - a brilliant player on the field and even better person off the field."

Wigan and Great Britain rugby league legend Shaun Edwards:

"From a working class lad in Cardiff to the King of Wigan - that is Sir Billy Boston."

Sky Sports Rugby League's Brian Carney:

"When the Wigan representatives stood in the Boston household in Tiger Bay, Cardiff in 1953 and offered Billy a career in rugby league in the North of England it was Billy's mother who told him in no uncertain terms that he would be taking the offer.

"We all have Mrs Boston to thank for giving rugby league one of its finest ever. Billy glowed greatness.

"I have listened to the hardest of rugby league men from Billy's era talk about his presence on the field. The hulking figure they dare not get angry.

"A sensational try scorer who could handle himself if and when the game got physical. Thanks for everything you gave people Billy."

Boston's journey to icon status

On August 6 1934 in Cardiff, Billy Boston was born to his father John, a seaman from Sierra Leone and his mother Nellie, from the city's Irish community.

Primarily a winger and centre, Boston's rugby career began in the 15-player code in which he represented Wales at youth level.

However, it was not without its struggles. His hometown club Cardiff RFC did not offer him and other Black and mixed-race players a contract.

Such racism also denied him the opportunity to represent Wales and with it, he made the decision to switch codes and join Wigan Warriors.

At 18 years of age in March 1953, Boston signed for Wigan before making his debut eight months later. That would be the first of 488 and crossing the whitewash became customary as he scored 478 tries across that time.

In 1954 more history followed when Boston became the first non-white player to be selected for a Great Britain Rugby League Lions Tour.

Boston became a World Cup winner in 1960, scoring a try in Great Britain's win over Australia and then a second Lions Tour followed in 1962.

His international career saw him score 24 tries across 31 Tests for Great Britain. His other Tour appearances added a remarkable 53 tries in 27 games.

After 16 years with Wigan, Boston joined Blackpool Borough and made 11 appearances and scored five tries, ending his domestic career with 499 appearances.

Boston's career ended at 36 years of age and the statistics are staggering. He scored 571 tries, the second most in rugby league history.

A rugby league immortal, he has three statues - situated in Wales, Wigan, and at Wembley Stadium.

articles.title: WWE Raw Just Got Exciting Again After Shock Debut and More Fallout Including a Booking Fail
articles.summary: As WWE ramps up for a journey to Mexico City next month, the August 24 edition of Raw on Netflix delivered spectacle from the Canadian Tire Centre in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada.
articles.body:
As WWE ramps up for a journey to Mexico City next month, the August 24 edition of Raw on Netflix delivered spectacle from the Canadian Tire Centre in Ottawa.

LA Knight and Solo Sikoa challenged The Usos only to be attacked by the returning Royce Keys and his new allies from NXT, OTM.

Penta and Rey Fénix advanced to the finals of the luchador No. 1 contender tournament in great matches with La Parka and Dragon Lee, respectively.

This and more highlighted an exciting show for Raw that might have set the red brand back on track.

Massive Shocker Changes Everything on Raw

While it looked like the battle lines in WWE were set as Solo Sikoa and LA Knight collided with The Bloodline, a new group has arrived to shake things up.

Despite previously working with Sikoa and Knight, Royce Keys led an attack alongside Bronco Nima and Lucien Price from NXT against the popular babyfaces.

This sets the stage for three conflicting sides to battle on Raw, elevating multiple underused names on Raw who could soon be seen as top stars.

In particular, this heel turn makes Keys feel like a real threat for the first time since his WWE arrival, and he is backed by two talented, hungry newcomers in OTM.

With the consistently growing popularity of Knight and Sikoa, any heels who contest them will get heat.

This also gives the conflict with The Bloodline, which was already running out of steam, new life as fresh faces are caught in the mix.

Suddenly, anything can happen, and all WWE needs to do is stay unpredictable. That has been difficult for the company previously, though.

Stephanie Vaquer Shows Exactly Why WWE Needs Her

Stephanie Vaquer is back in the action, and she looked great against Roxanne Perez, clearly working at her physical peak again in the ring.

These are the kind of matches that keep fans invested in the Raw women's division, highlighting the talent that can perform at the highest level.

La Primera can deliver this performance against anyone on Raw, and WWE should let her do so.

Do not simply keep her in a backstage segment after a likely loss to Liv Morgan. She should be wrestling.

WWE should find ways from singles to tag to six-man action to keep stars like Vaquer, Perez, Iyo Sky, Sol Ruca and more wrestling at least every other week.

While the women's division on Raw still feels understaffed with numerous absences, the teased arrival of Lola Vice soon should help.

The former NXT women's champion will be a quick hit on the main roster due to her hard-hitting in-ring style and flashy presentation.

Vice is a star both in style and talent that can instantly elevate the midcard women's division while she establishes her name.

In particular, pitting her against Women's intercontinental champion Raquel Rodriguez gives an important fresh challenger to that title scene.

She and Sol Ruca can serve as the primary babyfaces to capture the gold while Lyra Valkyria and Roxanne Perez are the main heel threats.

This is a strong foundation built off recent years of NXT and suddenly makes this division look relevant.

If WWE really wants to make Vice shine off the bat, it would make sense for her to even take the gold from Rodriguez, even just in a short reign like Ruca's.

With the championship switching hands, it will be clear that anyone on this roster is a threat to capture the gold at any time.

He has beat up and slowed the momentum of Je'Von Evans, who was already the slowest riser of the fresh NXT call-ups.

At most, his threat also extends to luchadors like Penta, Dragon Lee and Rey Mysterio, but the big man beating up the smaller competitors is not compelling storytelling on its own.

Cass has more charisma than he has showcased so far, even if the plan is not for Enzo Amore to join him on Raw.

He could at least talk as much as Baron Corbin has on SmackDown, who is awkwardly looking like the better fit in the same role as Cass.

If WWE does not find a way to showcase Cass' personality soon, he is going to become a lost cause, falling back into the pack like Rusev and Ethan Page before him.

If WWE needs fresh names on Raw who can instantly work crowd-pleasing matches, there is no better place to look than AAA.

La Parka, El Hijo de Dr. Wagner Jr., Psycho Clown, Laredo Kid and El Fiscal all delivered in their spots for the No. 1 contender tournament.

The only shame was that WWE had not highlighted them all more before this to sell them as real threats to win over the luchadors working Raw and SmackDown.

Raw could use a good 20-minute block weekly for AAA luchadores to showcase their talent against established Raw stars.

Add in El Hijo del Vikingo and Octagón Jr. when they are healthy alongside more opportunities for Mr. Iguana, and the rotation of luchadores could become the spectacle match Raw needs.

This is not even mentioning the possibility of Flammer, Lady Shani, La Catalina and Faby Apache adding fresh names to the women's division rotation.

AAA is a company owned and run by WWE. Why not try to elevate the talent in AAA while making Raw better weekly?

articles.title: Ex-Wimbledon champion Vondrousova appeals to CAS over four-year doping ban
articles.summary: The Czech was issued a suspension in June after she did not submit her sample when notified by a doping control officer.
articles.body:
Former Wimbledon champion Marketa Vondrousova has appealed to the Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS) against her four-year ban for missing a doping test last year, the sport’s highest judicial body said.

CAS on Tuesday confirmed the receipt of the appeal and said a hearing had not yet been scheduled. Vondrousova’s ban ends on June 21, 2030, when she will be 30.

list 1 of 4 Gauff, Fils win Cincinnati tennis titles in run-up to US Open

list 2 of 4 Tennis star Kyrgios provisionally suspended after positive test for cocaine

list 3 of 4 ‘I have never doped’: Vondrousova says after receiving four-year tennis ban

list 4 of 4 Kenya’s former New York marathon champion Korir gets five-year doping ban

Vondrousova was issued the suspension in June after the International Tennis Integrity Agency said the Czech did not submit her sample when notified by a doping control officer in an out-of-competition test attempt at her home in December.

The 27-year-old said in April she had “reached a breaking point after months of physical and mental stress” and added that an officer arriving at 8:15pm demanding an immediate test felt like a serious intrusion into her privacy.

Vondrousova has said she never doped , and a test taken three days after the December 3 incident came back negative.

The former world number six has not played since skipping the Adelaide International in January due to a shoulder injury and has dropped to world number 153.

She won the 2023 Wimbledon title, having previously made the French Open final in 2019 and bagged a silver medal at the Tokyo Olympics in 2021.

articles.title: Tottenham sign Brazilian winger Savinho from Manchester City
articles.summary: Savinho’s arrival, which comes in a busy transfer window for Spurs, takes their spending past $400m.
articles.body:
Tottenham Hotspur have signed Brazil winger Savinho from Manchester City in a deal that takes their close-season spending above 300 million pounds ($409m) under manager Roberto De Zerbi, having just escaped relegation last term.

Both clubs confirmed the transfer on Monday, but the financial details and length of contract were not disclosed. British media last week reported that the deal was worth 75 million pounds ($102.2m) and included a further 10 million pounds ($13.63m) in add-ons.

list 1 of 4 Maresca says he needs time after ‘big changes’ at Man City

list 2 of 4 Arsenal face Man City in Community Shield before EPL return – all to know

list 3 of 4 Marmoush brace helps Man City defeat Atletico Madrid in South Korea

list 4 of 4 Man City beat Palace to close gap with Arsenal to 2, with two games to play

“[Savinho] is a player who brings energy, imagination and quality in wide positions. He has the courage to attack defenders and the ability to change a game with his creativity,” De Zerbi said in a statement.

“We’re very pleased to have him with us, and I’m looking forward to working with him, helping him continue to grow and seeing him bring his personality to the team.”

Savinho started at Atletico Mineiro and joined Troyes in 2022, but his breakout season came on loan at Girona, where he scored 11 goals in 41 appearances as they finished a club-high third in La Liga in 2024 and qualified for the Champions League.

He moved to City in the close season that year and has since made 84 appearances in all competitions, scoring seven goals. The 22-year-old has also played 13 times for Brazil.

Savinho is the latest arrival at Spurs in a busy transfer window that has included the signings of midfielders Sandro Tonali and Mateus Fernandes, plus defenders Andy Robertson, Marcos Senesi and Jan Paul van Hecke.

Savinho’s transfer takes the North London club’s outlay up to 322 million pounds ($438.9m), if the add-ons in the deal are included, as they revamp the squad after finishing a lowly 17th last season.

According to British media, Spurs are also in talks over a move for City’s Egyptian forward Omar Marmoush.

Tottenham began the Premier League campaign with a 3-0 loss at Brentford on Saturday. They next host Championship (second-tier) Charlton Athletic in the League Cup second round on Wednesday before hosting Newcastle United on Saturday.

articles.title: Al volante del Audi más bestia de la historia: 1.001 CV y más rápido que un Lamborghini
articles.standfirst: Hemos conducido el Nuvolari, el Audi de calle más extremo de la historia: 1.001 CV, 351 km/h, DRS y una producción limitada a 499 unidades.
articles.summary: Hemos conducido el Nuvolari, el Audi de calle más extremo de la historia: 1.001 CV, 351 km/h, DRS y una producción limitada a 499 unidades.
articles.body: Para desarrollar desde cero el superdeportivo más potente de su historia, Audi utilizó sus recursos internos para tenerlo listo en tan solo 405 días (poco más de un año), contando desde la primera reunión en la que se aprobó el proyecto. Más concretamente, recurrió a Lamborghini y tomó prestados el chasis y el motor del reciente superhíbrido enchufable Temerario. Para bautizarlo, recurrió al nombre de Tazio Nuvolari, un piloto italiano de enorme talento de las décadas de 1930 y 1940, ganador de carreras de motociclismo, Le Mans, la Mille Miglia y Grandes Premios. En este último caso, a finales de la década de 1930, A finales de la década de 1930, pilotaba monoplazas de Auto Union (la marca que más tarde estaría en el origen de Audi). Su nombre ya se había utilizado en el prototipo que fue precursor de un Audi de producción en 2003, y ahora revive en el que es el coche de producción más potente de la historia de Audi, limitado a 499 unidades. Y con un precio superior a 600.000 euros por unidad. Tecnológicamente, no deja de ser un concepto cercano al de los monoplazas de Fórmula 1 y los prototipos de resistencia actuales, que combina una enorme potencia de propulsión de combustión con la ayuda de la energía eléctrica para mejorar el rendimiento y la tracción, además de incorporar elementos de aerodinámica activa. Y, en este contexto, se posiciona para cumplir el viejo lema del automovilismo de "ganar el domingo para vender el lunes". El Nuvolari es el primer vehículo de producción que adopta la nueva filosofía de diseño de Audi (que, cronológicamente, debutó en el Concept C), y destaca por sus superficies tensas y la configuración de motor central/trasero que define sus proporciones y su volumen monolítico. La carrocería impacta igualmente con el nuevo color exclusivo de Audi, Titanio, utilizado también en el Audi Concept C y en el monoplaza de Fórmula 1. Detrás de esta filosofía de diseño más minimalista (denominada "Radical next") se encuentra Massimo Frascella, el italiano que comenzó su carrera en Bertone, pasó por el Grupo Ford, lideró el diseño de Jaguar/Land Rover y fue contratado a principios del verano de 2024 para definir las líneas de los futuros Audi. “Cada elemento externo cumple una función aerodinámica bien definida, desde el alerón delantero hasta el difusor trasero. Y todo es tal como se ve, ya sea fibra de carbono o aluminio, tanto en el exterior como en el interior”, explica Gael Buzyn, director del centro de diseño avanzado de Audi en Malibú, EE. UU., con quien compartí esta primera experiencia dinámica con el Nuvolari. También llama la atención que la carrocería esté prácticamente desprovista de aristas afiladas, pero eso no significa que su excepcional rendimiento no quede anticipado por sus formas monolíticas y limpias, a diferencia de lo que vemos en un Lamborghini. “La colaboración entre diseñadores e ingenieros fue fundamental, asegurando que cada elemento de la carrocería tuviera una razón de ser funcional”, añade el diseñador francés, quien lleva 20 años afincado en Estados Unidos. En este sentido, "la colaboración de los pilotos del equipo de Fórmula 1, Nico Hülkenberg y Gabriel Bortoleto, fue fundamental durante la fase de desarrollo de este proyecto", como destacó Viktor Underberg, director de Rendimiento de Coches Deportivos de Audi, quien fue mi copiloto durante los aproximadamente 10 kilómetros de esta experiencia exclusiva al volante del Nuvolari. Bortoleto, por ejemplo, mencionó durante el desarrollo dinámico que lo que inmediatamente le llamó la atención en las pruebas de Nardò fue la precisión y previsibilidad del coche en las curvas: "Básicamente, no hay subviraje, lo que es impresionante dado el nivel de rendimiento. El equilibrio se mantiene muy neutro y preciso, lo que proporciona la confianza necesaria para mantener la velocidad en las curvas. Se puede sentir claramente cómo los diferentes sistemas, especialmente la aerodinámica y la distribución del par, trabajan en conjunto", explicó el brasileño.  Underberg (quien había trabajado previamente en Audi antes de su paso por Lamborghini en los últimos años) destaca que "se prestó una enorme atención al equilibrio entre la carga aerodinámica y la resistencia para maximizar la estabilidad y, por consiguiente, permitir un control preciso del Nuvolari". El chasis, la suspensión y la distancia entre ejes son los mismos que los del Temerario, con un ligero aumento del ancho de vía de 1 cm delante y 2 cm detrás. El S-Duct delantero (que entra por el parachoques y sale por el capó) proporciona carga aerodinámica adicional, reduciendo la sustentación a altas velocidades y mejorando la refrigeración del motor. Pero el elemento central del sistema de aerodinámica activa es el ala trasera adaptativa retráctil, que controla la fuerza descendente y la resistencia aerodinámica en tres configuraciones: cerrada, carga baja (low downforce) y carga alta (high downforce). En la posición Cerrada, el ala trasera se retrae para minimizar la resistencia aerodinámica y mejorar la eficiencia. En las configuraciones de alta y baja carga se generan diferentes niveles de carga aerodinámica según la dinámica de conducción y el modo seleccionado (el alerón se eleva desde la posición cerrada a la baja carga a 70 km/h, desciende a 50 km/h y pasa a la posición alta carga a 140 km/h). En los modos orientados al rendimiento, como Dinámico, Dinámico+ y Pista, el ala trasera se activa de forma totalmente automática. En las rectas, el sistema cambia a la posición de baja carga para optimizar la velocidad máxima y la estabilidad. El Sistema de Reducción de Resistencia Aerodinámica (DRS), conocido por su uso en la Fórmula 1, se puede activar manualmente (excepto en el modo E-Hybrid) mediante un botón en el volante, permitiendo así alcanzar una velocidad máxima de 351 km/h. Además, el sistema permite elevar automáticamente el ala en curvas a alta velocidad, de modo que la aerodinámica activa contribuya a la eficacia del pilotaje. Durante la frenada y el paso por curva, adopta la posición CA para aumentar la carga aerodinámica y favorecer el control. En esta configuración, el Audi Nuvolari puede generar más de 400 kg de carga aerodinámica a una velocidad de 290 km/h. El Nuvolari combina un chasis de aluminio con paneles externos de CFRP (plástico reforzado con fibra de carbono). Se utilizan procesos de fabricación derivados del automovilismo, como piezas de fibra de carbono preimpregnadas y curadas en autoclave, para lograr la máxima ligereza y rigidez. El Nuvolari también utiliza llantas forjadas con fijación central de un solo perno, algo único en un modelo Audi de producción en serie (aunque heredado del Temerario). Los neumáticos son 255/35 ZR20 delante y 325/30 ZR21 detrás. El sistema de frenado es electrónico (brake-by-wire), por lo que el pedal de freno no tiene conexión física con las ruedas, como sucede en los sistemas hidráulicos convencionales, ya que el proceso se realiza mediante una bomba controlada electrónicamente. Esto facilita la combinación de frenado regenerativo e hidráulico sin variación en la sensación del pedal. Los frenos emplean discos de carbono-cerámicos con un sistema de refrigeración interno que, según los ingenieros alemanes, mejora la disipación del calor en un 21% en comparación con los discos cerámicos de carbono convencionales. Cuenta con pinzas fijas de diez pistones delante y de cuatro detrás. El Audi Nuvolari quattro está equipado con un sistema de "comportamiento predictivo", un ordenador que procesa datos sobre el ángulo de dirección, la aceleración, la velocidad de guiñada y el agarre disponible. Con esta información, el sistema decide cómo distribuir el par motor, la fuerza de frenado y la carga aerodinámica. Hay cinco modos de conducción para elegir: E-Hybrid, para circular en eléctrico por ciudad o en trayectos cortos; Equilibrado (Balanced), para un buen equilibrio entre confort, eficiencia y rendimiento; Dinámico (Dynamic), que ofrece una respuesta más inmediata; Dinámico+ (Dynamic+), que prioriza el rendimiento; y Circuito (Track), el más extremo, con ajustes específicos para pista, incluyendo niveles más tolerantes en el control de tracción. La arquitectura minimalista concentra todos los controles dinámicos esenciales en el volante, para que el conductor pueda centrarse en su misión y sentirse en el centro del mundo. Antes de conducir el Nuvolari, fui copiloto del CEO de Audi, Gernot Döllner, quien me confirmó que esta filosofía minimalista también se hará más visible en los Audi más convencionales en el futuro. "Por supuesto, no llegaremos al extremo del Nuvolari, un hiperdeportivo que prioriza la conducción sobre el rendimiento, pero sí reduciremos el número de pantallas en los Audi del futuro, porque creemos que la impresión orgánica y los controles físicos/analógicos transmiten una imagen más prémium que las pantallas". Es algo similar al contraste entre los relojes analógicos y digitales en el mundo de la relojería. Los asientos ligeros complementan el concepto de interior centrado en el conductor. La estructura de fibra de carbono en la base y en el respaldo reduce el peso, aumenta la rigidez y proporciona una mayor sujeción lateral. Este par se utiliza para eliminar el retardo del turbo, suavizar la entrega de potencia del V8 para generar una respuesta más fluida, próxima a la de un motor atmosférico, acelerar los cambios de marcha y activar la función de Launch Control (arranque desde parado sin deslizamiento de las ruedas). Por lo tanto, si el funcionamiento es el mismo que en el Lamborghini, su contribución al par máximo del sistema será de unos 70 Nm (730 del V8 más estos 70 Nm). La propulsión eléctrica añade 201 CV a los 800 del V8 de gasolina (esa es también la potencia disponible cuando el Nuvolari circula exclusivamente en modo eléctrico) para alcanzar los 1.001 CV mencionados anteriormente. Underberg me explica que potencialmente esta contribución podría llegar a 280 CV, pero eso solo serviría para aumentar la potencia máxima durante un breve periodo: "Preferimos una cifra de potencia máxima menor, 1.001 CV, pero este rendimiento es constante y duradero, y la velocidad máxima se puede mantener durante más de cuatro minutos". El sistema híbrido se alimenta de una batería de iones de litio de 7,3 kWh (casi el doble de capacidad que la utilizada en el Lamborghini), instalada donde normalmente se monta el eje de transmisión en un quattro, que no existe en este caso. Su prioridad es suministrar y recuperar energía rápidamente —el Nuvolari puede desacelerar hasta 0,3 g solo mediante regeneración— y no la autonomía eléctrica, que es secundaria, sobre todo porque una batería más grande aumentaría el peso y perjudicaría el rendimiento. No fue una prueba de conducción exhaustiva (eso vendrá después), sino una primera experiencia al volante del Nuvolari, que, según el ingeniero jefe que me acompañaba, representa al 98% el modelo de producción final. Recorrimos unos 10 kilómetros por una carretera sinuosa dentro de una reserva privada en las afueras del pintoresco pueblo de Carmel, cerca del circuito de Laguna Seca, a 180 kilómetros al sur de San Francisco. Me indicaron que no superara los 70 km/h, así que fue una experiencia de conducción preliminar y tranquila. El sonido del V8 es agradable incluso a bajas velocidades, y las aceleraciones iniciales son impresionantes, aunque evidentemente sin poder acercarnos a sus prestaciones máximas. La dirección es más ligera de lo habitual para un hipercoche, y el volante (revestido en Alcántara) también es más fino, dos claras preferencias de Viktor Underberg, como me confesó anteriormente en la presentación de otros deportivos de Audi, especialmente los modelos RS. Pero no por ello es menos precisa y razonablemente directa (2,5 vueltas del volante de tope a tope). Toda mi atención se centró en la pequeña área del panel de instrumentos y en la cara del volante, donde se ubican los cuatro botones que controlan todo lo relacionado con la dinámica: Launch Control modos de conducción, DRS, programas Wet (Mojado), Dry (Seco) y Recharge (Recarga), modo Track (Circuito) y función de elevación hidráulica del morro (dos centímetros). Al pulsarlos rápida o lentamente se activan diferentes funciones y también se pueden girar para acceder a otras configuraciones… pero resulta confuso controlar tantos reglajes de diferentes maneras. Es cierto que un periodista conduce muchos coches a la semana y acaba necesitando tiempo para familiarizarse con el sistema (yo pasé alrededor de una hora en el coche), pero los futuros propietarios del Nuvolari podrían experimentar algo similar. Al fin y al cabo, en sus garajes probablemente tendrán muchos otros coches que alternarán con el Audi más potente y rápido de la historia. Dejé mis críticas constructivas al director ejecutivo de la marca alemana y al director del proyecto, quienes agradecieron los comentarios, pero será difícil que esto cambie dada la filosofía de base del Nuvolari, centrada en mantener siempre la mirada del conductor en la carretera.
paragraphs: Para desarrollar desde cero el superdeportivo más potente de su historia, Audi utilizó sus recursos internos para tenerlo listo en tan solo 405 días (poco más de un año), contando desde la primera reunión en la que se aprobó el proyecto. Más concretamente, recurrió a Lamborghini y tomó prestados el chasis y el motor del reciente superhíbrido enchufable Temerario. Para bautizarlo, recurrió al nombre de Tazio Nuvolari, un piloto italiano de enorme talento de las décadas de 1930 y 1940, ganador de carreras de motociclismo, Le Mans, la Mille Miglia y Grandes Premios. En este último caso, a finales de la década de 1930, A finales de la década de 1930, pilotaba monoplazas de Auto Union (la marca que más tarde estaría en el origen de Audi). Su nombre ya se había utilizado en el prototipo que fue precursor de un Audi de producción en 2003, y ahora revive en el que es el coche de producción más potente de la historia de Audi, limitado a 499 unidades. Y con un precio superior a 600.000 euros por unidad. Tecnológicamente, no deja de ser un concepto cercano al de los monoplazas de Fórmula 1 y los prototipos de resistencia actuales, que combina una enorme potencia de propulsión de combustión con la ayuda de la energía eléctrica para mejorar el rendimiento y la tracción, además de incorporar elementos de aerodinámica activa. El Nuvolari es el primer vehículo de producción que adopta la nueva filosofía de diseño de Audi (que, cronológicamente, debutó en el Concept C), y destaca por sus superficies tensas y la configuración de motor central/trasero que define sus proporciones y su volumen monolítico. La carrocería impacta igualmente con el nuevo color exclusivo de Audi, Titanio, utilizado también en el Audi Concept C y en el monoplaza de Fórmula 1. Detrás de esta filosofía de diseño más minimalista (denominada "Radical next") se encuentra Massimo Frascella, el italiano que comenzó su carrera en Bertone, pasó por el Grupo Ford, lideró el diseño de Jaguar/Land Rover y fue contratado a principios del verano de 2024 para definir las líneas de los futuros Audi. “Cada elemento externo cumple una función aerodinámica bien definida, desde el alerón delantero hasta el difusor trasero. Y todo es tal como se ve, ya sea fibra de carbono o aluminio, tanto en el exterior como en el interior”, explica Gael Buzyn, director del centro de diseño avanzado de Audi en Malibú, EE. UU., con quien compartí esta primera experiencia dinámica con el Nuvolari. También llama la atención que la carrocería esté prácticamente desprovista de aristas afiladas, pero eso no significa que su excepcional rendimiento no quede anticipado por sus formas monolíticas y limpias, a diferencia de lo que vemos en un Lamborghini. “La colaboración entre diseñadores e ingenieros fue fundamental, asegurando que cada elemento de la carrocería tuviera una razón de ser funcional”, añade el diseñador francés, quien lleva 20 años afincado en Estados Unidos. En este sentido, "la colaboración de los pilotos del equipo de Fórmula 1, Nico Hülkenberg y Gabriel Bortoleto, fue fundamental durante la fase de desarrollo de este proyecto", como destacó Viktor Underberg, director de Rendimiento de Coches Deportivos de Audi, quien fue mi copiloto durante los aproximadamente 10 kilómetros de esta experiencia exclusiva al volante del Nuvolari. El equilibrio se mantiene muy neutro y preciso, lo que proporciona la confianza necesaria para mantener la velocidad en las curvas. Se puede sentir claramente cómo los diferentes sistemas, especialmente la aerodinámica y la distribución del par, trabajan en conjunto", explicó el brasileño.  Underberg (quien había trabajado previamente en Audi antes de su paso por Lamborghini en los últimos años) destaca que "se prestó una enorme atención al equilibrio entre la carga aerodinámica y la resistencia para maximizar la estabilidad y, por consiguiente, permitir un control preciso del Nuvolari". El chasis, la suspensión y la distancia entre ejes son los mismos que los del Temerario, con un ligero aumento del ancho de vía de 1 cm delante y 2 cm detrás. articles.title: Could Gavin McKenna push Auston Matthews into a new role in the Toronto Maple Leafs NHL lineup
articles.summary: NHL News: With the Toronto Maple Leafs drafting Gavin McKenna first overall, the possibility of reshaping their lineup around him raises intriguing questions about Auston Matthews' role and potential scoring combinations this NHL season.
articles.body: The Toronto Maple Leafs enter the 2026-27 NHL season with the first overall selection in the 2026 NHL Draft, Gavin McKenna, under a microscope. The teenager has yet to play an NHL game, but his arrival is already generating buzz around possible line combinations.Toronto still revolves around Auston Matthews, but the emergence of another top-level offensive talent would give the coaching staff more options. An interesting option would be to have McKenna skate with William Nylander and John Tavares.Could Gavin McKenna join Toronto Maple Leafs top six?Gavin McKenna could be a candidate for a top-six role if he proves in training camp he can handle the speed and physicality of the NHL right away. The Toronto Maple Leafs donât have to push him, but his offensive game could make it harder to decide.William Nylander is entering the season with 79 points, 30 goals and 49 assists in 65 games. At age 35, John Tavares continued to produce, finishing the season with 71 points in 82 games: 31 goals, 40 assists.McKenna joining Nylander and Tavares would give Toronto another potentially potent scoring unit. If the three forwards develop chemistry, it could also pose a tough tactical problem for opposing NHL teams.But that doesnât necessarily mean Auston Matthews would drop in the lineup. Matthews continues to be the leading center for the Toronto Maple Leafs and a huge part of their offensive structure.The training camp and preseason games should be the best barometer for how quickly McKenna can get meaningful NHL minutes. The Toronto coaching staff can see his consistency, defensive responsibility, skating and ability to handle tougher competition before making a decision.A safer bet would be McKenna in a lesser role in the lineup as he adjusts to the NHL. If he adapts quickly, then more responsibility could be on the cards.What would this mean for Auston Matthews?A McKenna breakthrough would provide Jim Hiller with more options in his lineup, notnecessarily take away from the importance of Matthews. Toronto had the ability to spread the scoring out over a number of lines, which may have lessened the burden on one unit to produce the majority of the offence.Right now McKenna's top-six role is still a projection and not a set plan. Still, the possibility is illustrative of the type of buzz surrounding the first overall selection for the Toronto Maple Leafs as the new NHL season approaches.The arrival of Gavin McKenna has prompted new discussion around the Toronto Maple Leafs' forward combinations. The first overall pick could be in line for a top-six role with established scorers William Nylander and John Tavares. If McKenna can make a quick transition, his offensive contributions could give head coach Jim Hiller more flexibility in his lineup next season.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.standfirst: Periodista justificó medida contra hinchas de Millonarios y desató la furia azul
articles.summary: Periodista justificó medida contra hinchas de Millonarios y desató la furia azul
articles.body: El debate sobre la convivencia, el control de la violencia y las restricciones a las hinchadas visitantes en el fútbol profesional colombiano volvió a encenderse tras la postura expresada por un periodista deportivo en favor de las medidas de seguridad adoptadas para restringir el ingreso de aficionados de Millonarios en la ciudad de Medellín. Las restricciones para partidos de alto riesgo —que suelen incluir el cierre de fronteras para barras visitantes o protocolos estrictos de identificación— buscan garantizar el orden público y evitar altercados dentro y fuera de los escenarios deportivos. Sin embargo, la defensa pública de estas disposiciones por parte de comunicadores ha generado opiniones divididas en la opinión pública y en las redes sociales. Por un lado, quienes respaldan las medidas argumentan que la prioridad absoluta debe ser la seguridad ciudadana y la integridad de los asistentes al estadio. Desde esta perspectiva, restringir la presencia masiva de hinchadas rivales en encuentros de alta rivalidad minimiza los focos de tensión y facilita la labor de la Policía y las autoridades locales en materia de control y prevención. Por otro lado, sectores de la hinchada 'embajadora' y diversos analistas rechazan la medida y las opiniones que la justifican, catalogándolas como una generalización injusta que castiga a toda la afición por los actos de unos pocos. Los detractores de este tipo de restricciones sostienen que cerrar fronteras o limitar el acceso perpetúa la estigmatización del hincha, limita el derecho a la libre circulación y representa un retroceso en los esfuerzos por vivir el fútbol en paz y con fronteras abiertas. El episodio pone nuevamente en el centro de la discusión el rol de los medios y comunicadores deportivos al abordar temas de seguridad e hinchadas. Mientras algunos consideran que la prensa debe respaldar las decisiones institucionales en pro de la convivencia, otros señalan que el periodismo debe cuestionar medidas restrictivas y promover soluciones de fondo en lugar de avalar soluciones punitivas o de exclusión. La polémica deja en evidencia la compleja relación entre la pasión futbolística, la gestión de la seguridad en las grandes ciudades y el impacto que tienen las opiniones periodísticas en la percepción de los hinchas y el desarrollo de la Liga local.

articles.title: Real Madrid’s Mourinho ‘happy’ with transfers despite Rodri miss
articles.summary: Yan Diomande topped Real’s transfers, and Jose Mourinho says he is happy despite missing out on Rodri to Barcelona.
articles.body:
Real Madrid coach Jose Mourinho says he is “very happy” with his squad, which he considers complete despite missing out on midfielder Rodri, later signed by rivals Barcelona.

Los Blancos revamped their squad this summer, signing six players including record arrival Yan Diomande , Bernardo Silva and Marc Cucurella.

list 1 of 4 Big-spending Tottenham sign Brazilian winger Savinho from Manchester City

list 2 of 4 Premier League: Chelsea start Alonso era with thrilling 3–2 win at Fulham

list 3 of 4 Ex-Liverpool star Fabinho reunited with Mohamed Salah at Trabzonspor

list 4 of 4 Arsenal sign Konsa from Villa as Premier League holders bolster defence

However, Madrid’s approach for Rodri broke down, meaning that, beyond former Man City playmaker Silva, they have not strengthened in midfield.

“For me the squad is closed, but the market is still open – you never know if a player will come and say ‘I’ve been benched twice and I want to leave,'” Mourinho told reporters on Tuesday.

“In theory, no [more deals]… but something could always happen… In my head the squad is closed, and I have not asked for anyone. I am very happy with the players I have.”

With midfield maestros Toni Kroos and Luka Modric departing in 2024 and 2025 respectively, Madrid have struggled to control matches.

Mourinho’s side snatched a late 2-1 win at Espanyol on Saturday in their La Liga opener, starting with Silva and Federico Valverde together in midfield.

Mourinho said French defensive midfielder Aurelien Tchouameni was not ready to play against Real Sociedad on Wednesday.

“He’s got a problem, the holiday time wasn’t enough [for him to recover], seeing the games approaching, the player wanted to try … but we’ve decided that you can’t start a season in suffering,” explained the coach.

“You can finish a season suffering, the last couple of months, but you can’t start in August not at 100 percent.

“So we decided with him, the staff, the medical department, to get him to return at 100 percent.”

Mourinho said he had faith in Uruguayan international Valverde as a midfielder, despite previous coaches using him in a variety of roles, including right-back and right winger.

“For me he is a player for the centre of the pitch,” added Mourinho.

“Depending on the opponent and our objectives, he might be more set in his position or more mobile.”

Mourinho said that in modern football, players’ positions were less relevant.

“I don’t want to identify Tchouameni as the No. 6, Camavinga No. 6, Fede No. 8, Bernardo No. 10 … things dilute during games.”

articles.title: Duro golpe al Deportivo Pereira: Acolfutpro pide formalmente su liquidación judicial por impagos
articles.standfirst: Acolfutpro pide a Supersociedades la liquidación del Deportivo Pereira: las razones de la solicitud
articles.summary: Acolfutpro pide a Supersociedades la liquidación del Deportivo Pereira: las razones de la solicitud
articles.body: La tranquilidad institucional y deportiva del Deportivo Pereira vuelve a tambalearse. La Asociación Colombiana de Futbolistas Profesionales (Acolfutpro) presentó una solicitud formal ante la Superintendencia de Sociedades para que se declare la liquidación judicial del club matecaña, tras denunciar sistemáticos incumplimientos en el pago de las obligaciones laborales del plantel profesional. De acuerdo con el comunicado oficial emitido por el gremio de futbolistas, la institución risaraldense incurrió en el impago de los salarios correspondientes al mes de julio y la primera quincena de agosto, afectando directamente el sustento de los jugadores y sus familias. El punto neurálgico del reclamo radica en la situación jurídica en la que se encuentra la entidad: "Nuestros compañeros del Pereira, quienes ven afectado su sustento y el de sus familias, merecen respeto, cumplimiento y condiciones laborales dignas", señaló Acolfutpro en su pronunciamiento. Esta nueva encrucijada legal y administrativa genera profunda preocupación en la afición pereirana, recordando los oscuros capítulos del pasado en los que el club ya había atravesado un extenso proceso de liquidación. La situación resulta paradójica considerando la historia reciente de la institución: El destino inmediato del equipo de la 'Perla del Otún' queda en manos de la Superintendencia de Sociedades, organismo que deberá evaluar los descargos de la directiva, verificar el estado de los pagos y determinar si concede el plazo legal para el saneamiento o si ratifica el inicio de la liquidación judicial. Mientras se aguarda una respuesta o pronunciamiento oficial por parte de la dirigencia del Pereira, los futbolistas mantienen su reclamo por garantías laborales básicas, dejando en vilo el futuro del conjunto matecaña en el FPC.

articles.title: Luis Javier Suárez podría ir a la Premier League: Nottingham Forest busca el fichaje
articles.standfirst: Giro en el mercado: Nottingham Forest quiere dar el golpe y llevarse a Luis Javier Suárez de Portugal
articles.summary: Giro en el mercado: Nottingham Forest quiere dar el golpe y llevarse a Luis Javier Suárez de Portugal
articles.body: El cierre del mercado de pases en Europa promete emociones de último minuto para los futbolistas colombianos en el exterior. Uno de los nombres más codiciados de la ventana de transferencias es el de Luis Javier Suárez, delantero del Sporting de Lisboa, cuya continuidad en la Liga de Portugal ya no está garantizada ante el creciente interés del Nottingham Forest de la Premier League. Aunque en semanas recientes el atacante 'cafetero' había sido relacionado con gigantes europeos como el Barcelona, en las últimas horas surgió una alternativa concreta desde territorio británico. Según reportó el prestigioso medio francés L'Équipe, el Nottingham Forest ha puesto la lupa sobre Suárez para reforzar su frente de ataque. La operación no se perfila como un simple rumor de pasillo, sino como una negociación con posibilidades reales de concretarse antes del pitazo final del periodo de transferencias. "Luis Suárez, el delantero del Sporting que sigue de cerca al Barcelona, podría finalmente fichar por el Nottingham Forest", subraya L'Équipe A pesar de que el atacante es una pieza valiosa en el esquema del Sporting de Lisboa, la dirigencia del club portugués estaría dispuesta a negociar bajo una condición específica: el alto valor de mercado del colombiano. De concretarse el traspaso, Luis Javier Suárez daría el salto a la liga más competitiva del mundo, sumándose a la baraja de colombianos que buscan dejar huella en el fútbol de Inglaterra.

articles.title: Root ‘hacked off’ by England cricket team after police handcuff Carse
articles.summary: After Brydon Carse dropped by England for second Test against Pakistan, captain Joe Root blasts ‘stupid mistakes’.
articles.body:
Joe Root has expressed frustration that a winning return as England Test captain has been overshadowed by another off-field incident that saw Brydon Carse dropped for the second Test against Pakistan.

Carse has been referred to the Cricket Regulator after videos on social media appeared to show the fast bowler being led away by police in handcuffs following an incident at a nightclub in Derby on Saturday.

list 1 of 4 Real Madrid’s Mourinho ‘happy’ with transfers despite Rodri miss

list 2 of 4 Big-spending Tottenham sign Brazilian winger Savinho from Manchester City

list 3 of 4 Ex-Wimbledon champion Vondrousova appeals to CAS over four-year doping ban

list 4 of 4 Ex-Liverpool star Fabinho reunited with Mohamed Salah at Trabzonspor

It is the latest in a series of alcohol-fuelled controversies that have dogged England since a disastrous tour of New Zealand and Australia at the end of last year.

White-ball captain Harry Brook was involved in an altercation with a nightclub bouncer in Wellington, and videos circulated of opener Ben Duckett appearing drunk on a night out during the 4-1 Ashes series thrashing by Australia.

In June, former captain Ben Stokes and Gus Atkinson were given written warnings and stood down from the second Test against New Zealand after an incident at a London nightclub that occurred after they broke a curfew.

Stokes announced his shock retirement from international cricket during the third Test a few days later, paving the way for Root to return for a second spell as red-ball captain.

England thrashed Pakistan by an innings and 103 runs inside three days of his first match back in charge last week.

“If I’m being brutally honest, I’m really hacked off. I’m really disappointed that after last week’s performance, we’re sat here and we’re talking about something that is not related to it at all,” Root said at a news conference on Tuesday.

“It’s not the isolated incident itself. It’s the fact we continuously keep making stupid mistakes away from the game and it’s detracting from what we are doing on the field.”

A curfew on players going out was introduced in January after the troubled tour Down Under.

However, Root has said he will not impose a curfew because he does not believe it is a productive way to change the culture around the England squad.

“I still don’t believe that’s the way to go. It’s important we create something bigger than that. It’s about having something long lasting that we can be proud of,” the 35-year-old said.

“Clearly, we are not portraying ourselves how we want to, and I think we have an opportunity to build a culture that is very strong, that we can be proud of, that is player-driven, and of course, that isn’t going to happen overnight.

“We have already had conversations as a team on what is expected from this group of players, what it means to play for England, what it takes to play for England.

“We want to create something that we can be proud of, that people who follow us can be proud of.”

Carse was not selected for the first Test and has been withdrawn from the squad for the second Test, which begins at Lord’s on Thursday.

“Clearly, we are not portraying ourselves how we want to, and I think we have an opportunity to build a culture that is very strong, that we can be proud of, that is player-driven, and of course, that isn’t going to happen overnight.
“We have already had conversations as a team on what is expected from this group of players, what it means to play for England, what it takes to play for England.
“We want to create something that we can be proud of, that people who follow us can be proud of.”
Carse was not selected for the first Test and has been withdrawn from the squad for the second Test, which begins at Lord’s on Thursday.

articles.title: New NHL Rumors Update Quinn Hughes' Contract Talks, Trade Buzz with Wild Ahead of 2026-27 Season
articles.summary: Three weeks before training camps open and one month before the start of the 2026-27 NHL regular season, Quinn Hughes' future with the Minnesota Wild is becoming a big question mark.
articles.body:
Three weeks before training camps open and one month before the start of the 2026-27 NHL regular season, Quinn Hughes' future with the Minnesota Wild is becoming a big question mark.

On the latest episode of his 32 Thoughts podcast, Elliotte Friedman of Sportsnet said there's no indication there have been "a ton of talks recently between Hughes and the Wild" as he enters the final season of his current contract.

Meanwhile, The Athletic's Michael Russo reported the team has not been engaged with the New Jersey Devils or any team in regards to Hughes:

"One source, speaking on the condition of anonymity to discuss negotiations that aren't public, went as far as to tell The Athletic on Tuesday that the rumors are 'bulls--t,' 'made up' and 'invented BS by bloggers'"

Hughes was acquired by the Wild from the Vancouver Canucks last December. He had spent the first eight years of his career in Vancouver, but a trade came about after his camp reportedly informed Canucks officials at some point early last season that he wouldn't commit to signing an extension.

Minnesota sent Marco Rossi, Zeev Buium, Liam Öhgren and a 2026 first-round pick (No. 24 overall) to Vancouver in exchange for Quinn.

The Athletic's Michael Russo reported on July 2 that Wild general manager Bill Guerin called the New Jersey Devils to inquire about Jack Hughes, Quinn's younger brother, in a potential trade.

No deal came out of those discussions, but it's plausible the Wild were taking steps in an attempt to entice Hughes to sign an extension. The Devils were connected to Quinn before he was traded to Minnesota.

Hughes told reporters in May after the Wild's season ended with a second-round playoff loss to the Colorado Avalanche that he would like some clarity on his future going into next season, adding that he is "open" to an extension with Minnesota.

"I really like it here. I would definitely be open to re-signing. We'll see what Billy wants to do," Hughes said. "We're 36 hours removed [from elimination]. I'm not sure I'm ready to get into details, what they would look like."

One potential issue is the value of a Hughes' extension. He is currently the 35th highest-paid defenseman in the NHL by average annual salary $7.85 million per season on the six-year, $47.1 million deal he signed in October 2021.

Hughes has far exceeded that deal, including winning the Norris Trophy during the 2023-24 season.

Bowen Byram of the Chicago Blackhawks is the highest-paid defenseman at $12.5 million annually on the six-year, $75 million extension he signed in July. Erik Karlsson ($11.5 million), Rasmus Dahlin ($11 million) and Drew Doughty ($11 million) round out the top four defensemen by average annual salary.

Hughes finished last season with 69 assists, eighth-most in the league, and helped the Wild win a playoff series for the first time since 2015.

Minnesota will open the 2026-27 regular season on Oct. 1 against the Nashville Predators.

articles.title: Infantino’s presidency under threat: FIFA elections, challengers, dates
articles.summary: Amid waning support and growing criticism, the FIFA chief looks to hold onto his powerful position in world football.
articles.body:
FIFA President Gianni Infantino, currently the most powerful man in world football, appears to be pulling out all the stops in a bid to retain his position despite growing calls for his ouster and wide-ranging disapproval of his plans.

The 56-year-old has been in charge of FIFA for over 10 years and is seen as a divisive figure in international football, with his close ties to some of the most powerful global leaders and plans for maximising revenue from football viewed as a threat to the game.

list 2 of 4 Big-spending Tottenham sign Brazilian winger Savinho from Manchester City

list 3 of 4 Ex-Wimbledon champion Vondrousova appeals to CAS over four-year doping ban

list 4 of 4 Ex-Liverpool star Fabinho reunited with Mohamed Salah at Trabzonspor

With a little over six months until the next round of elections for FIFA’s presidency, Infantino appears to be losing ground among his usual backers in national football federations and regional confederations.

Here’s a look at where Infantino stands in terms of support and what challenges lie ahead for him and FIFA:

Why is Infantino being challenged as FIFA president?

While the Swiss head of FIFA has never been a widely popular figure with football fans, he has enjoyed support amongst leading figures in the sport and global leaders.

This popularity, however, has waned over the past few months, especially since making no secret of his close ties with United States President Donald Trump and announcing FIFA’s plans to privatise the World Cup in order to maximise revenue from the tournament.

The FIFA chief first met Trump at the White House in 2018 after the US was awarded the co-hosting rights to the 2026 FIFA World Cup. Infantino has since made several public appearances with the US president, including at the so-called Summit for Peace in Egypt in October 2025.

Infantino was the target of widespread scathing criticism in December, when he handed the inaugural FIFA Peace Prize to the US president at the FIFA World Cup 2026 draw held at the Kennedy Centre in Washington, DC.

The final blow to the global football chief’s position came in the days after the World Cup, when he invited private investors to buy a stake in future profits from World Cups and all FIFA events. The investor group was led by Joshua Kushner , an American businessman who is also the younger brother of Trump’s son-in-law Jared Kushner.

While the ensuing backlash – which included pledges by European nations to boycott FIFA events and claims from senior staff that Infantino deceived everyone – led Infantino to announce Friday that he was abandoning the plan , irreparable damage had already been to his reputation.

He now faces a race against time to garner support in his push for an extraordinary fourth term as president.

How many terms can one FIFA president have?

FIFA presidents are limited to three terms in office, with each term lasting four years.

However, in 2022, Infantino successfully argued that his first spell in charge, which began when he was elected at an extraordinary FIFA Congress ⁠in 2016 following Sepp Blatter’s resignation, should not count towards that limit because it completed an interrupted mandate.

His plans to run for a fourth term have been questioned by critics and rights groups, who have asked FIFA’s Governance, Audit and Compliance Committee (GACC) to block Infantino’s re-election bid.

What are the key dates for FIFA elections and how do they work?

The polls to elect FIFA’s next president will be held at the global governing body’s next congress, which is slated for March 18, 2027 in Rabat, Morocco.

All challengers vying for the post must declare their candidacy by November 18.

The candidates will face off in a poll involving all 211 FIFA member nations, with 106 votes required to pick a winner.

Who are the likely candidates to challenge Infantino for the FIFA presidency?

European football (UEFA) chief Aleksander Ceferin has ruled himself out from the running and no individuals have announced their plans to challenge Infantino openly.

However, a number of regional FIFA confederation chiefs and some other powerful figures in global football have been tipped as potential candidates . They are:

Victor Montagliani, president of the Confederation of North, Central America and Caribbean Association Football (CONCACAF)

Nasser al-Khelaifi, chairman of the European Club Association (ECA) and president of Paris Saint Germain football club

Sheikh Salman bin Ebrahim Al Khalifa, president of the Asian Football Confederation (AFC)

Patrice Motsepe, president of the Confederation of African Football (CAF)

How has Infantino reacted to the challenge?

The FIFA chief has been scrambling to gather support and has made public appearances despite having being advised to maintain a low profile. He was asked by Montagliani to skip an Under-14 football event in the Caribbean last week but Infantino posted photos on his Instagram account, showing his meeting with political and football officials from the Dominican Republic.

The move was seen as an attempt to seek support from the regional football officials, but a FIFA statement quoted Infantino as saying: “It’s important to engage, to have a dialogue, to express views and opinions – a lot [has] been happening in the last few weeks and it’s important that you hear, you listen and you’re able to, also, express what your feelings are.”

Infantino’s latest public appearance was in France on Monday, where he attended the closing ceremony of the Esports World Cup at the Grand Palais in Paris and was seated besides French President Emmanuel Macron and the Crown Prince and Prime Minister of Saudi Arabia Mohammed bin Salman.

Which national football federations and regional confederations are backing Infantino?

Despite the ongoing crisis, Infantino has found longstanding support from the African confederation , with CAF’s top decision-making body late siding with the ⁠FIFA president.

Mexico and Argentina have also put their weight behind him, with South America’s CONMEBOL football governing body issuing a statement this month to reject any attempt to oust Infantino that did not involve a vote of all 211 members.

The FIFA Under-20 Women’s World Cup is less than two weeks away, with the tournament kicking off on September 5 in Poland.

While UEFA issued a statement earlier this month saying its 55-member association remains committed to boycotting FIFA competitions, the competition is slated to go ahead as scheduled.

articles.title: Chinese robot Tiangong clocks sub-9-second 100 metres in Beijing
articles.summary: Chinese robot seven-tenths of a ⁠second faster than the 9.58-second men’s world record set by Usain Bolt in 100m.
articles.body:
China’s Tiangong ⁠Ultra humanoid robot ran 100 metres in 8.86 seconds at the World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing on Tuesday, lowering the 9.39-second mark it set at the event’s opening.

The time was more than seven-tenths of a ⁠second faster than the 9.58-second men’s human world record set by Jamaican sprinting great Usain Bolt in 2009.
